title: One row per story in the stage indexes (head-stage index)
description: A story is stored as one Item row per version, and a saved version keeps the stage it was written in, so the stage index (listItemsByStageAndUpdatedAt) holds superseded versions: on Machines on Machines 456 of the 580 rows in the Published partition are superseded, and 26 board cards showed an old version (10 published stories in Copywriting). Design: docs/plans/story-head-stage-index.md. Recommendation: a sparse headStageKey attribute plus one new GSI (listItemsByHeadStageAndUpdatedAt) that only the head row of a lineage carries, set and cleared in the writes that already flip versionState (no extra writes per save). PR #1361 (versionState ne superseded filter) is the stop-gap. Each child marked deploy:backend needs Ryan's approval to deploy, per site. Ryan decides on the design before any implementation.
